Restart this deal

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Cash a premium versus protect its access, keep flexible vowels versus expensive consonants, play a short hook forming several cross-words versus long main word, or exchange at tempo cost.

Take a seat
How to play
9×9 board, seven-tile rack, finite public vocabulary searchable by prefix. Each turn place contiguous row/column word connecting existing board; every perpendicular cross-word must also be valid. Reuse existing letters, score all new words by letter values with one-use letter/word premiums. Blank chosen once at placement scores zero. Exchange selected tiles only with at least seven in bag, or pass. Draw replacements after commit.
Bag empty and one rack empty, or six combined passes, ends; subtract remaining rack values and transfer them on going out. Higher score wins; equal draw.
A 36-combined-turn cap also closes the game with normal rack adjustments. Use the public dictionary browser buttons to inspect allowed words; all placement uses native buttons, with Tab/Enter keyboard access.

No timer. No account. A fresh approach is always welcome.

How to play
9×9 board, seven-tile rack, finite public vocabulary searchable by prefix. Each turn place contiguous row/column word connecting existing board; every perpendicular cross-word must also be valid. Reuse existing letters, score all new words by letter values with one-use letter/word premiums. Blank chosen once at placement scores zero. Exchange selected tiles only with at least seven in bag, or pass. Draw replacements after commit.
Bag empty and one rack empty, or six combined passes, ends; subtract remaining rack values and transfer them on going out. Higher score wins; equal draw.
A 36-combined-turn cap also closes the game with normal rack adjustments. Use the public dictionary browser buttons to inspect allowed words; all placement uses native buttons, with Tab/Enter keyboard access.

How to play
9×9 board, seven-tile rack, finite public vocabulary searchable by prefix. Each turn place contiguous row/column word connecting existing board; every perpendicular cross-word must also be valid. Reuse existing letters, score all new words by letter values with one-use letter/word premiums. Blank chosen once at placement scores zero. Exchange selected tiles only with at least seven in bag, or pass. Draw replacements after commit.
Bag empty and one rack empty, or six combined passes, ends; subtract remaining rack values and transfer them on going out. Higher score wins; equal draw.
A 36-combined-turn cap also closes the game with normal rack adjustments. Use the public dictionary browser buttons to inspect allowed words; all placement uses native buttons, with Tab/Enter keyboard access.

How to play
Three players each receive seven cards. Each chooses one face down, all reveal into scoring tableau and pass remaining hand left; repeat to exhaustion, three rounds with alternating direction. Six card families: pairs worth5; triples worth10; each dumpling increasing1/3/6/10/15; roll-icons most6/second3; sauce doubles next single nigiri2/3/4; desserts remain across rounds and majority+6/minority−6 at match end. A once-per-round chopstick card already drafted may be returned into passing hand to take two cards from current hand. Fixed public score reference. Tied roll places share that bonus rounded down. If all dessert counts tie, no dessert bonus or penalty applies.
Most points after third-round dessert adjustment wins; equal draws, otherwise loss.
